scanNote:
WORKBOOK 29-BET. Unit 7 — kiyim, ob-havo, Present Continuous.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 2-mashq (4), 3-mashq (10 bo'shliq), 4-mashq (4 shaxsiy javob), 5-mashq (8 ta '-ing'), 6a (6 odam), 6b (5 tuzatish), 7-mashq (6 savol) — jami 43 ta javob.

⚠ 3-MAShQ — FE'L VA SIFAT JUFTLIGI: har bandda avval FE'L, keyin undan yasalgan SIFAT keladi.
  snowing → snowY · blowing → windY · clouds → cloudY · shining → sunnY · raining → rainY
  ⚠ 2-band boshqacha: fe'l 'blowing' (shamol esmoqda), lekin sifat 'windY' — boshqa o'zakdan.
  ⚠ 4-band ham: 'the SUN is SHINING' ikki so'z, sifati esa 'sunny'.

⚠ 5-MAShQ — '-ING' IMLOSI:
  undosh ikkilanadi: swim → swimMING, run → runNING, sit → sitTING
  '-e' tushadi: shine → shinING, make → makING, decorate → decoratING
  oddiy: read → readING, do → doING

⚠ 6a — SURATDAGI OLTI ODAM: Ben (kostyum va galstuk, raqsga tushyapti), Hannah (uzun ko'ylak, raqsga tushyapti), Joanna (kurtka va yubka, muzqaymoq yeyapti), Thomas (kurtka va shim, Amanda bilan gaplashyapti), Amanda (ko'ylak, Thomas bilan gaplashyapti), Adam (ko'ylak, ichimlik quyayapti).

⚠ 6b — TUZATISh QOLIPI IKKI QISMLI: avval inkor ('No, she ISN'T eating'), keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot ('She IS drinking').
  ⚠ Har beshala gapda ham xato ISh-HARAKATDA, odam nomida emas — suratga diqqat bilan qarash kerak.

⚠ 4-MAShQ — JAVOBLAR NAMUNA: bu savollar o'quvchining o'zi haqida. Bizdagi javoblar namuna; har kim o'zinikini yozadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  socks ..... paypoqlar (doim ko'plikda)
  sandals ... sandal, ochiq oyoq kiyim (doim ko'plikda)
  pyjamas ... pijama (doim ko'plikda)
  a coat .... palto

Har bir savolda GAP MA'NOSIGA qarang:
  qo'l uchun → qo'lqop
  oyoq uchun → oyoq kiyim
  uyquda    → pijama
  sovuqda   → palto

items.textEn: 1  We wear ............ to keep our hands warm.
items.uz: Biz qo'limizni issiq saqlash uchun ... kiyamiz.
items.whyUz:
'hands' (qo'llar) → GLOVES (qo'lqoplar).
'socks' = paypoq (oyoq uchun); 'shorts' = kalta shim.

items.textEn: 2  On the beach, people wear ............ on their feet.
items.whyUz:
Plyaj — issiq va qumli → SANDALS (ochiq oyoq kiyim).
'boots' (etik) issiqda noqulay; 'hats' (shlyapa) — bosh kiyim.

'in bed' = karavotda, uxlaganda → PYJAMAS (pijama).
DIQQAT: 'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda.

items.textEn: 4  When it's cold, I wear my ............ .
items.whyUz:
Sovuqda issiq ustki kiyim kerak → COAT (palto).
'swimming-costume' — issiq havoda; 'blouse' — yengil bluzka.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR BANDDA IKKI USUL BIRGA KELADI:
  1) FE'L bilan  — It's snowing.
  2) SIFAT bilan — It's a snowy day.

OB-HAVO BELGILARI (rasmda):
  qor tushayotgan bulut  → snowing / snowy
  puflab turgan bulut    → the wind is blowing / windy
  bulutlar               → there are clouds / cloudy
  quyosh                 → the sun is shining / sunny
  tomchili bulut         → raining / rainy

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1-bandning birinchi so'zi — 'snowing'.

DIQQAT — SIFAT YASALISHI:
  snow → snowy,  wind → windy,  cloud → cloudy,
  sun → sunny ('n' ikkilanadi),  rain → rainy

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob. 'It's snowing' = qor yog'yapti.

snow + -y = SNOWY (qorli).
'a snowy day' = qorli kun.

'The wind is blowing' = shamol esayapti.
'to blow' → 'blowing' (oddiy -ing).
wind + -y = WINDY (shamolli).

items.textEn: 3  There are [bulut belgisi] ............ in the sky.
items.whyUz:
'There ARE ...' → KO'PLIK kerak: CLOUDS (bulutlar).
'the sky' = osmon.
cloud + -y = CLOUDY (bulutli).

items.hintUz: Osmondagi yorug'lik manbai va uning harakati
items.whyUz:
'The SUN is SHINING' = quyosh charaqlayapti.
'shine' → 'shining' (-e TUSHDI).
DIQQAT: 'the sun' — DOIM 'the' bilan (yagona narsa).
sun + -y = SUNNY. Diqqat: 'n' IKKILANADI.

'It's raining' = yomg'ir yog'yapti.
'rain' → 'raining' (oddiy -ing).
rain + -y = RAINY (yomg'irli).

exercises.explanationUz:
BU SAVOLLAR SHAXSIY — javob har kimda har xil bo'ladi.
Quyida namuna javoblar berilgan (O'zbekiston uchun).

FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:
  It's + sifat (+ and + sifat) + today.
  It's + fasl (now).
  My favourite season is + fasl.
  I like + fasl + because ...
  I love/like + fe'l-ING

items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. O'z ob-havongizga qarab o'zgartiring:
  It's cold and cloudy today.
  It's raining today.
  It's hot today.

NAMUNA javob. Fasl nomi kichik harf bilan yoziladi:
spring, summer, autumn, winter.

NAMUNA javob. Boshqa qolip: 'I like spring the best.'
'favourite' — britancha yozilishi.

items.textEn: 4  What do you like about it?
items.answer: I like spring because the weather is warm and everything is green. I love going for walks in the park.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. Sabab DOIM 'because' bilan.
'like/love + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'llaridan keyin -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the -ing form of the verbs below.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH IMLO QOIDASI:
  1) oddiy -ing:        read → reading
  2) undosh ikkilanadi: run → running
  3) -e tushadi:        make → making

items.whyUz: 2-qoida: sw-I-m → m IKKILANADI = swimming.
3-qoida: -E TUSHADI = shining.
3-qoida: -E TUSHADI = making.
2-qoida: r-U-n → n IKKILANADI = running.
3-qoida: -E TUSHADI = decorating.
2-qoida: s-I-t → t IKKILANADI = sitting.

1-qoida: oddiy -ing = reading.
'ea' — ikki unli, ikkilanish YO'Q.

1-qoida: oddiy -ing = doing.
'o' unli bilan tugaydi, lekin -e emas → tushmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. What are they wearing? What are they doing?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Ular nima kiygan? Nima qilishayapti?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA ZIYOFAT (party) MANZARASI:

  Joanna — chapda, kurtka va kalta yubkada, qo'lida stakan,
           ICHAYAPTI
  Hannah — uzun ko'ylakda, Ben bilan RAQSGA TUSHAYAPTI
  Ben    — kostyum va galstukda, Hannah bilan RAQSGA TUSHAYAPTI
  Thomas — o'rtada, kurtkada, qo'lida stakan,
           Amanda bilan GAPLASHAYAPTI
  Amanda — o'ngda, ko'ylakda, Thomas bilan GAPLASHAYAPTI
  Adam   — pastda o'tirgan, ko'ylakda, idishdan ichimlik QUYAYAPTI

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Ben is wearing a suit and tie. He is dancing.

QOLIP (ikki gap):
  1) Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
  2) He/She + is + fe'l-ING.

items.answer: Ben is wearing a suit and tie. He is dancing.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'a suit' = kostyum; 'a tie' = galstuk.

items.answer: Hannah is wearing a long dress. She is dancing.
items.whyUz:
Hannah uzun ko'ylak kiygan va Ben bilan raqsga tushayapti.
'dance' → 'dancing' (-e TUSHDI).

items.answer: Joanna is wearing a jacket and a skirt. She is drinking.
items.whyUz:
Joanna kurtka va kalta yubka kiygan, stakandan ichayapti.
'drink' → 'drinking' (oddiy -ing).

items.answer: Thomas is wearing a jacket and trousers. He is talking to Amanda.
items.whyUz:
Thomas kurtka va shim kiygan, Amanda bilan gaplashayapti.
'talk TO somebody' — 'to' predlogi shart.

items.answer: Amanda is wearing a dress. She is talking to Thomas.
items.whyUz: Amanda ko'ylak kiygan va Thomas bilan gaplashayapti.

items.answer: Adam is wearing a shirt. He is pouring a drink.
items.whyUz:
Adam ko'ylak kiygan va idishdan ichimlik quyayapti.
'to pour' = quymoq → 'pouring'.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the false statements as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Ben and Hannah are talking to Adam.
     No, they aren't talking to Adam. They are dancing.

JAVOB TUZILISHI (ikki qism):
  1) No, + ega + isn't/aren't + noto'g'ri fe'l-ING (+ qo'shimcha).
  2) He's/She's/They're + TO'G'RI fe'l-ING.

DIQQAT: birinchi qismda ISM emas, OLMOSH ishlatiladi:
  Ben and Hannah → they
  Joanna → she,  Thomas → he,  Adam → he,  Amanda → she

items.textEn: 1  Ben and Hannah are talking to Adam.
items.answer: No, they aren't talking to Adam. They are dancing.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
Ben va Hannah raqsga tushishayapti, Adam bilan gaplashmayapti.

items.answer: No, she isn't eating. She is drinking.
items.whyUz:
Joanna qo'lida STAKAN ushlab, ichayapti — yemayapti.
Birlik ega → ISN'T va SHE.

items.answer: No, he isn't dancing. He is talking to Amanda.
items.whyUz:
Thomas raqsga tushmayapti — Amanda bilan gaplashayapti.
Raqsga tushayotganlar — Ben va Hannah.

items.answer: No, he isn't talking to Amanda. He is pouring a drink.
items.whyUz:
Adam o'tirib idishdan ichimlik quyayapti — gaplashmayapti.
Amanda bilan gaplashayotgan — Thomas.

items.answer: No, she isn't drinking. She is talking to Thomas.
items.whyUz:
Amanda ichmayapti — Thomas bilan gaplashayapti.
Ichayotgan — Joanna.

exercises.instructionEn: Make questions as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  you/cook/dinner  →  Are you cooking dinner?

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING + qolgan qism?

SO'ROQ SO'ZI BO'LSA:
  So'roq so'zi + is/are + ega + fe'l-ING?
     what/he/do/at the moment
     → What IS HE DOING at the moment?

'BE' FE'LINI TANLASH:
  you → ARE;  Jennifer, the dog, he, she → IS

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'you' → ARE. 'cook' → 'cooking' (oddiy -ing).

'Jennifer' — birlik → IS.
'ride' → 'riding' (-e TUSHDI).

'you' → ARE.
'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq — HARAKAT, shuning uchun -ing mumkin.
'have' → 'having' (-e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: 4  the dog / sleep / in the garden
items.answer: Is the dog sleeping in the garden?
items.whyUz:
'the dog' — birlik → IS.
'sleep' → 'sleeping' (oddiy -ing).

items.textEn: 5  what / he / do / at the moment
items.answer: What is he doing at the moment?
items.whyUz:
Tartib: so'roq so'zi → 'be' → ega → fe'l-ing.
'What IS HE DOING ...?'
'do' → 'doing'.

'she' — birlik → IS.
1-band bilan solishtiring: 'Are YOU cooking?' / 'Is SHE cooking?'

wordFormation.introUz: 29-bet — ob-havo sifatlari va doim ko'plikdagi kiyimlar.

groups.explanationUz: Bir hodisani ikki xil aytish mumkin.
Juft yoki ikki qismli bo'lgani uchun -s bilan keladi. 'a' QO'YILMAYDI.

patterns.formula: We wear + kiyim + TO KEEP + ... warm.
patterns.exampleEn: We wear gloves to keep our hands warm.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz qo'limizni issiq saqlash uchun qo'lqop kiyamiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD.
'keep somebody/something warm' = issiq saqlamoq.

patterns.formula: It's + fe'l-ING.  ↔  It's a + sifat + day.
patterns.exampleEn: It's snowing. It's a snowy day.
patterns.explanationUz: Bir hodisani ikki xil aytish. Sifat -Y bilan yasaladi.

patterns.formula: No, + olmosh + isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING. + To'g'ri javob.
patterns.exampleEn: No, she isn't eating. She is drinking.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval inkor, keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot.
Ism o'rniga OLMOSH ishlatiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Are you cooking dinner? Is the dog sleeping in the garden?
patterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat pishiryapsizmi? It bog'da uxlayaptimi?

patterns.exampleEn: What is he doing at the moment?
patterns.explanationUz: So'roq so'zi eng OLDINDA, keyin 'be', keyin ega.

patterns.formula: Ism + is wearing + kiyim.  He/She is + fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: Ben is wearing a suit and tie. He is dancing.
patterns.exampleUz: Ben kostyum va galstuk kiygan. U raqsga tushayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikki gap: birinchisi kiyim, ikkinchisi mashg'ulot haqida.
